title: Creating a Net term shows a toast and puts it in every picker
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • A new name {Term-A} that no term has, and a customer {Customer-A} and a vendor {Vendor-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-08 Fourteen, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-08 Customer and {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-08 Vendor.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A} in a new tab.
  6. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
  7. Open Edit Vendor for {Vendor-A} in a new tab.
  8. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: the window closes and a green toast shows "{Term-A} created". {Term-A} appears on the Active tab between Net 7 and Net 15, its Due reads "14 days after the invoice date", and its Customers and Vendors read 0 and 0.
  • Step 5: Edit Customer opens.
  • Step 6: {Term-A} is offered, between Net 7 and Net 15, without reloading anything else.
  • Step 7: Edit Vendor opens.
  • Step 8: {Term-A} is offered there too, between Net 7 and Net 15.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R7: “On Create, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} created", and the term appears on the Active tab in its S1-R5 position, with 0 customers and 0 vendors, available at once in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit term created | "{name} created" | Success toast”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “On Create, a success toast shows "{name} created". On Save Changes, a success toast shows "{name} saved". Both are the same green toast as the page's other actions.”
  • Goals: “A shop can create a "Net X days" or "day of the following month" term and select it on any customer or vendor; invoices and vendor invoices dated afterwards show the due date the term defines.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
